parrafo.es: Rochelin Medical Spa and Wellness atiende en North Miami Beach con Botox, rellenos, láser, CoolSculpting y terapias de bienestar, bajo la supervisión del Dr. Rochelin. Un equipo que sus pacientes describen como cálido, organizado y atento a cada detalle.
parrafo.en: Rochelin Medical Spa and Wellness serves North Miami Beach with Botox, fillers, laser treatments, CoolSculpting and wellness therapies, under the supervision of Dr. Rochelin. A team patients describe as warm, organized and attentive to every detail.

parrafo_1.es: Rochelin Medical Spa and Wellness es la práctica del Dr. Rochelin en North Miami Beach, donde la medicina interna se combina con tratamientos estéticos y terapias de bienestar bajo un mismo techo.
parrafo_1.en: Rochelin Medical Spa and Wellness is Dr. Rochelin's practice in North Miami Beach, where internal medicine meets aesthetic treatments and wellness therapies under one roof.

parrafo_2.es: Las reseñas repiten lo mismo: un equipo cálido, organizado y que se toma el tiempo de explicar cada tratamiento. Naj Dieudonne agradeció la experiencia profesional y el seguimiento posterior a su consulta.
parrafo_2.en: The reviews keep pointing to the same thing: a warm, organized team that takes the time to explain every treatment. Naj Dieudonne thanked the staff for a professional experience with real follow up after the visit.

texto.es: Llamas y agendas tu visita. El equipo evalúa tu piel y tus objetivos antes de recomendar nada.
texto.en: You call and book your visit. The team evaluates your skin and goals before recommending anything.

texto.es: Se elige el tratamiento según tu piel y objetivo: Botox, relleno, láser, CoolSculpting o terapia de bienestar.
texto.en: The treatment is chosen for your skin and goal: Botox, filler, laser, CoolSculpting or a wellness therapy.

texto.es: El tratamiento se realiza en consultorio, con equipo médico y el cuidado que describen las reseñas.
texto.en: The treatment is done in office, with medical equipment and the care the reviews describe.

texto.es: El Dr. Rochelin y su equipo dan seguimiento después de la visita para resolver cualquier duda.
texto.en: Dr. Rochelin and the team follow up after your visit to answer any questions.

nota.es: Botox y relleno muestran el precio de la promoción vigente del propio consultorio. El resto de los tratamientos se cotiza en tu consulta, sin compromiso.
nota.en: Botox and filler show the price from the clinic's own current special. Every other treatment is quoted at your consultation, no obligation.

texto.es: Relajación de líneas de expresión con toxina botulínica, aplicada por el equipo médico.
texto.en: Expression line smoothing with botulinum toxin, applied by the clinic's medical team.

texto.es: Volumen y contorno facial con relleno dérmico, evaluado antes en tu consulta.
texto.en: Facial volume and contour with dermal filler, evaluated first at your consultation.

texto.es: CoolSculpting, depilación láser y escleroterapia de venas varicosas de las piernas.
texto.en: CoolSculpting, laser hair removal and sclerotherapy for varicose veins of the legs.

texto.es: Terapia IV de nutrientes, PRP para caída de cabello, thread lift y manejo de peso.
texto.en: IV nutrition therapy, PRP for hair loss, thread lift and weight loss management.

pie.es: ¿No ves lo que buscas? Llama igual, probablemente lo cubrimos.
pie.en: Do not see what you are looking for? Call anyway, we likely cover it.

items.quote: I want to thank the staff at this Medical Spa for a very professional and pleasant experience. I found the spa to be well maintained and clean. The staff were kind and courteous as well. The Doctor provided expertise analysis with sincere care. He took his time to go over everything and assured that I also understood everything.

I had a great experience with this clinic! The staffs were welcoming, organized, and efficient. The environment was well maintained, clean, with a calming atmosphere. The medical staff were professional and friendly, they listened to any concerns I may had, explained everything clearly and answered all my questions.
Great place everyone is so warm and welcoming. Everytime me and my husband come here we always leave with all our questions answered and they have a great candy selection in the front desk!

Doctor rochelin has been my go to doctor since 2022, I moved in the area in 2021 and had to go all the way to commercial to see my primary doctor until I thank god found him! He is not only personable but very knowledgeable and attentive. Highly recommend.
